I run Ebblemere Games, a studio based in the Philippines. We need purchases of Tidepatch, and I expect this campaign to deliver as many as possible. Completed game purchases are what we count; clicks alone are not the result we're after.

Run our X campaign from Thursday, April 29, 2027 through Sunday, May 2, 2027, all four days in the account's time zone, Manila time. This is a regular sales campaign with no special occasion. The landing page is https://ebblemeregames.com/tidepatch.

Here's the copy from our landing page: "Make room for slower days in Tidepatch, our farming and fishing life sim where you build floating vegetable terraces and restore a sleepy lagoon village. Get the complete game for US$18 with a one-time purchase. Available worldwide except Iran, North Korea, Cuba and Syria. Purchases are restricted to people aged 18 or older under our store's eligibility policy."

We sell everywhere we're eligible to serve on the same terms. Everything is localized: our product and landing page come in every major language, and we have a version of each post in every market's language, so people everywhere see us in their own language.

The site does not have X's pixel, so X cannot see our purchases. We count completed purchases in our own store records. You may launch and manage the campaign on your own without asking me for approval. Watch it throughout the flight and stay on top of its performance. At the end, send me a short recap with spend, impressions and link clicks. Keep it concise and accurate.

Total budget: 2,400.00 USD for everything you launch: every campaign and ad group draws on this one budget. We've approved these 3 posts, all on our account, and only these, so please don't write new ones. Promote whichever you think will work, in as many campaigns and ad groups as you like, and change, pause or stop them as you learn what works:
